name: Screen
description: On a Mac, agents can see what you're working on outside Vaultite: the app and window in front, a window's text (read with macOS's Accessibility) and its picture, and the companion's cursor can point there. It reads only when asked: you pressed fn with no text field, dropped the companion's cursor on a window, or an agent asked. Never a private app.

private_apps.label: Private apps
private_apps.description: apps agents never see: not their text, their picture or their windows' titles. An app's name or bundle id, one a line; com.vendor.* covers a vendor's apps
